name: a new generated scene becomes a phone lock screen
looks: A different full-bleed generated scene, a lone figure facing a distant eclipse, cuts in and holds, then shrinks and settles inside a phone mockup as its lock-screen wallpaper, tilted slightly over a soft swirling ribbon background.
build: The full-bleed scene cuts in and holds briefly before scaling down into the phone frame (power2.inOut); the phone is a DOM panel at a shallow steady tilt (ui-tilt-card); the ribbon background is a slow-moving gradient field behind it.
sound: A low pad under the full-bleed hold, a soft whoosh as it settles into the phone frame.
prompt: Hold a new full-bleed generated scene briefly, then shrink it down into a tilted phone mockup as its lock-screen wallpaper, over a slow, soft swirling gradient background, to show the same output living naturally on a real device.
